Meet Heng Chin Yong

I’m Heng Chin Yong (REN 65025), and I help expat families and investors buy commercial shoplots and factories in Johor Bahru. Over five years in real estate, I’ve sold more than 150 properties, with sales exceeding RM200 million. I can help you compare shoplots by visibility and parking, or look at whether a factory has the floor space and loading access you need. If you’re buying as an investment, we can talk through what tenants might look for in each property. I speak English, Mandarin and Bahasa Malaysia. If you have a property in mind, feel free to get in touch.
